# Pettifer

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Deceased
- **Role:** Criminal, gang member

## Appearance

Pettifer is described as an unkempt and sinister man with a rough, thuggish demeanor. He bears the physical signs of a harsh life on the streets and carries himself with an aggressive, threatening posture.

## Personality

Cruel, greedy, and ruthless, Pettifer relies on violence and intimidation to achieve his goals. He exhibits little loyalty or remorse, driven primarily by self-interest and malice toward those weaker than himself.

## Traits

- Ruthless
- Greedy
- Violent

## Abilities

- Street brawling and intimidation

## Goals

- Enrich himself through criminal acts and extortion

## History

Pettifer operates as a thug and criminal associate involved in illicit schemes. He serves as an antagonist to the protagonists, enforcing demands through threats and brute force. His criminal activities eventually lead him into direct conflict with the main characters. Ultimately, his violent actions catch up with him, resulting in his downfall and death.

## Background by volume

- Operated within the criminal underworld, engaging in extortion and violence
